claims: The 2026 NCAA Men’s Basketball Tournament "First Four" play-in games will take place on Tuesday, March 17, and Wednesday, March 18, in Dayton, Ohio.
The 2026 NCAA Men’s Basketball Tournament "First Four" play-in games consist of four games.
The 2026 NCAA Men’s Basketball Tournament "First Four" play-in games determine the final teams to qualify for the 64-team Round of 64 bracket.
The 2026 NCAA Men’s Basketball Tournament "First Four" play-in games feature the lowest-ranked automatic qualifiers and at-large teams.
